You are implementing M8 Task 1 for the agent-hub backend (FastAPI + SQLAlchemy async, Python 3.13): admin router skeleton + user management.

## Task Description
Read your task brief first — it is your requirements, use its exact names/values:
`/home/zhaodan/work/PythonProjects/agent-hub/.superpowers/sdd/2026-11-11-m8-admin-console/task-1-brief.md`

Also read the plan's Global Constraints and Rulings (R1–R10): `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-11-m8-admin-console.md` (at least §Global Constraints/Review Focus/契约总览/假设与开放问题). The plan is the authority; the brief is the task slice.

## Dependency already delivered
M7 is complete (HEAD `129d020`): `AdminUser` exists, non-admin 403 is `forbidden` with `details.required_role="admin"`, and every denial writes `security.rbac_denied` via an independent session. Verify with:
```bash
grep -n "required_role" app/core/deps.py
grep -rn "security.rbac_denied" app | head
```
Do not re-implement M7.

## Scope for this task (T1 only, do not build T2–T6)
Create `app/modules/admin/__init__.py`, `router.py`, `schemas.py`, `service.py`; mount the router in `app/api/v1/router.py` with `include_router(admin_router, responses=COMMON_ERROR_RESPONSES)`; add `tests/integration/test_admin_users.py`.
- `GET /api/v1/admin/users`: `q` (email/display_name ilike, escape `%`/`_`/`\`, max 100), `role` (user|admin), `status` (active|disabled), `limit` 1–100 default 20, `cursor` max 500. Sort `created_at DESC, id DESC`. Cursor payload `{"created_at": <datetime>, "id": <UUID>}`; invalid/missing fields → 422 `validation_error`. `stats` = counts under the same filters: `total/active/disabled/admins` (current filter semantics per plan).
- `GET /api/v1/admin/users/{user_id}`: 404 `not_found` when missing; same shape as list item; never return `password_hash`.
- `PATCH /api/v1/admin/users/{user_id}` body `{role?, status?}` with `extra="forbid"` and at least one non-null (else 422); rules: cannot change own role → 422 `cannot_change_own_role`; cannot disable self → 422 `cannot_disable_self`; if demoting/disabling an active admin who is the last active admin → 409 `last_admin_protected` with `details={"active_admins": 1}`; use `SELECT id FROM users WHERE role='admin' AND status='active' ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE`, then refresh the target and compute remaining; no actual change → return 200 without audit; real change → `write_audit(actor_type="user", actor_id=str(admin.id), action="admin.user.update", resource_type="user", resource_id=str(target.id), detail={"fields": sorted(changed), "role": target.role, "status": target.status})`, commit + refresh.
- Every endpoint uses `AdminUser` + `DbSession`. Non-admin 403 envelope is already handled by `require_admin`.
- Do NOT modify docs/openapi.json or docs/*.md (T7 owns docs). Do not change other modules.

## Testing notes
- Test file `tests/integration/test_admin_users.py`; use fixtures `client`, `admin`, `admin_auth`, `user`, `register_user`/`auth_headers` from `tests/conftest.py`. Note fixtures are DB rows created per test (conftest truncates tables between tests).
- For the last-active-admin service-layer test: use the `user` fixture object as the actor (service layer does not check actor role; route layer does), target = `admin` (the only active admin), e.g. `actor = await db.get(User, user.id)`, then `with pytest.raises(ConflictError)` around `admin_service.update_user(db, actor, admin.id, AdminUserPatchRequest(role="user"))`; assert code and `await db.rollback()`. Do not reference an undefined `registered` dict.
- Cover per brief: list/filter/stats/cursor, detail/404, patch role+status+audit, self-role/self-disable 422, last-admin 409, disable other admin when another remains, non-admin 403 with `details.required_role` on all 3 endpoints (use valid body for PATCH), unauthenticated 401, invalid cursor 422, empty/extra patch field 422.
- TDD: write failing tests first, run to observe RED (import/404), then implement.

## Environment / commands
- Work from `/home/zhaodan/work/PythonProjects/agent-hub`; `.venv/bin/python`.
- Test DB must be `agent_hub_test`:
  `TEST_DATABASE_URL="$(grep '^DATABASE_URL=' .env | cut -d= -f2- | sed 's#/agent_hub$#/agent_hub_test#')" .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/integration/test_admin_users.py -v`
  Never use dev `agent_hub` (conftest truncates tables).
- Full suite once before committing: same env + `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q` (~2 min now: baseline 760 passed), and `.venv/bin/python -m ruff check .`.

## Commit rules
Only `git add` the exact files you changed. Never `git add -A` / `git add .` (unrelated untracked plan docs exist). Local commit only; no push, no branch deletion.

## You Do Not Dispatch Subagents
Do all work yourself; never spawn a subagent or reviewer.

The agent integrating the work must review the final diff and run relevant tests.

Prefer showing the primary results within your final response alongside a brief explanation. Use ![Description](<path/to/image.png>) when an image supports an explanation or comparison. Use [Description](<path/to/image.png>) when referring to an image or listing files. Enclose Markdown file destinations in angle brackets, especially paths containing spaces. Do not call present just to list edited source files, or run commands to check whether a diff view will appear. Use present to publish complete deliverables, including images, Office documents, spreadsheets, and slide decks, when separate access helps the user. Hosts that support file cards can show the presented file with preview and open actions. Avoid repeating results already shown inline unless the separate card adds useful access. Outside commands, configuration expressions, and code blocks, link every mention of an existing file, including repeats and tables, to its full path relative to the working directory or absolute; append #L24 or #L24-L30 to the target for known lines. Use the filename or a clear alias as the label, adding only enough parent directories to distinguish files; keep full paths out of labels. Default to the name alone; when precise locations matter, append :24 or :24–30, with no # or L in the line suffix.

The checkout location and current working directory are separate values and may differ; never infer the working directory from the checkout path. Use pwd to determine the current working directory. Use this checkout only to inspect or extend DSH itself.

When the user refers to "this page", "this GUI", or "this app" without naming another target, they mean this GUI. The browser provides no implicit DOM, route, or screenshot context. Every other change — the apps/web shell and plain packages — requires rebuilding the affected Web artifacts and verifying this existing URL after a page refresh. Do not start a replacement server unless the user asks; if one is needed, use a managed background job and verify its exact URL.

tools.name: bash
tools.description: Execute a bash command (`bash -c`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh shell; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Managed `$DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. An unset variable expands to an empty string, so guard variables in such paths with `${VAR:?}`. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "npm install" → "Install package dependencies".

Use action "search" or "get" to read topic bodies before answering questions about the user's preferences, the project, or earlier decisions. Use action "save" when the user asks you to remember something or when they state a durable preference, decision, conclusion or reference; use action "update" to correct an existing topic instead of saving a duplicate. Use action "forget" only when the user explicitly asks to delete a memory. Use action "extract" to distill the current session into memory on demand. Live profiles apply changes immediately, including upgrades of installed packages; a change result that is not applied carries nextStep, which says what to do or tell the user. Unmet DSH version requirements (engines.dsh, else DSH peer dependencies) block installation and activation. Version exemptions risk crashes and data loss: warn the user and obtain explicit permission for the exact plugin and runtime versions before granting one.

If the user needs to review files earlier, such as before a tool call that waits for their answer, link them in your message instead. Use it when the user needs a separate file, especially Office documents, spreadsheets, and slide decks; prefer your final response when that suffices. tools.name: schedule_create
tools.description: Create a scheduled task. At each occurrence of rrule, prompt is delivered to the target session as a scheduled message from the user. The result includes the task id and the next occurrence as scheduledAt in UTC and scheduledAtLocal in the zone of rrule. After downtime, only the latest missed occurrence is delivered. Delivery can repeat after a crash.

title.description: Task name of at most 120 characters in the user's language: action plus object. Omit timing, status, ids, and bracketed suffixes.

rrule.description: Supported RFC 5545 subset: one DTSTART line, a newline, and one RRULE line. DTSTART ends in Z for UTC or carries TZID with an IANA time zone; a fixed offset such as UTC+5 is Etc/GMT-5, with the sign reversed. DTSTART must name an existing local time. A TZID rule keeps local clock time across daylight-saving changes; generated nonexistent local times are skipped, and repeated ones occur once, at the earlier instant. DTSTART may be in the past; delivery starts with the first occurrence after creation. A one-time delivery is RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=1. No SECONDLY; BYSECOND takes one value. COUNT is at most 1000; use UNTIL for longer rules. MINUTELY and HOURLY accept no BY parts, so select clock times with DAILY or WEEKLY plus BYHOUR and BYMINUTE. BYMONTHDAY and ordinal BYDAY require MONTHLY or YEARLY; BYYEARDAY and BYWEEKNO require YEARLY. Ordinal BYDAY cannot combine with BYWEEKNO. Each FREQ period allows at most 10080 candidates before BYSETPOS, which accepts at most 31 values. UNTIL is a UTC instant ending in Z. Example: "DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Singapore:20260901T080000\nRRULE:FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR;BYSETPOS=-1"

target.description: this_session delivers to this session; new_once delivers to the same new session every time, opened at the first delivery; new opens a different new session for every delivery. New sessions use this session's working directory and preset. With this_session or new_once, a delivery waits until the previous one finishes, and only the latest occurrence that passed meanwhile is delivered. Use this_session for reminders and for follow-ups to this conversation; use new_once or new for independent work, such as a recurring report, and whenever the user asks for a new conversation.

tools.name: subagent
tools.description: Delegate a self-contained task to a subagent (a separate agent that works in its own context) to offload focused, independent work — research, a scoped implementation, an analysis — so it does not consume this conversation's context. The subagent returns its result, not its intermediate steps. This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its name. If you are still online when it finishes, the runtime automatically delivers its completion notice. The notice includes the final answer unless the child sent you a message just before finishing. Use `send_message` to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes. Omit `provider`, `model`, and `reasoning_effort` to use child defaults, falling back to compatible parent values.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

3: > **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.
4: 
5: **Goal:** 在不新增数据库迁移的前提下，为管理控制台交付真实契约：用户列表/详情/角色与状态管理、只读概览、平台默认指令、系统技能、系统 MCP、全局 Agent 的查询与管理，复用 M7 的 `AdminUser` 门禁、既有领域服务、统一错误信封与游标分页，并同步 OpenAPI / `docs/api.md` / 前端交接。
6: 
7: **Architecture:** 新增 `app/modules/admin/` 作为**薄 HTTP 适配层**（`router.py` / `schemas.py` / `service.py`）：只有「用户管理」与「概览」是全新业务，SQL 与规则放 `admin/service.py`；平台指令、系统技能、系统 MCP、全局 Agent 的校验、审计与生效优先级仍留在各自领域服务（`instructions` / `skills` / `mcp` / `agents`），管理路由只做参数转换与 `AdminUser` 门禁，避免复制 SSRF、`secret:` 解析、`force_disabled` 合并等易漂移逻辑。所有新端点挂在 `/api/v1/admin/*`，读接口不分页或复用不透明游标，写接口落审计；**无迁移**。
8: 
9: **Tech Stack:** FastAPI、SQLAlchemy 2.x async、Pydantic v2、pytest-asyncio、httpx、PostgreSQL（复用本机 `dev_postgres`）。不新增第三方依赖。
10: 
11: **Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-11-m7-m9-backend-roadmap-design.md` §4（M8 范围/验收/非目标）
12: 
13: **前置基线:** M7-2 已交付 `AdminUser` RBAC（403 `forbidden` + `details.required_role="admin"` + `security.rbac_denied` 审计）；当前迁移 head `2d8f6a1c3e70`；M7 结束时的全量测试全绿。
14: 
15: ## Global Constraints
16: 
17: - Python `>=3.13`；ruff `line-length = 100`；代码注释、docstring、API 描述、用户可见错误消息一律中文。
18: - **不新增迁移**：M8 只读写既有列，禁止修改 `app/db/models/` 与 `alembic/versions/`。已核对：
19:   `users.role/status`（M1）、`system_settings`/`user_settings`（M1）、`skills.scope/enabled/force_disabled` 与 `mcp_servers.scope/enabled/force_disabled`（M1.5）、`remote_agents.owner_user_id`（M2）、`user_capability_overrides`（M1.5）均已存在；
20:   T8 必须用 `alembic check` 证明无漂移，且 `alembic/versions/` 无新文件。
21: - 复用既有依赖/信封/分页/审计，不自造：
22:   - 路由依赖 `app.core.deps.AdminUser` / `DbSession`；403 由 M7 的 `require_admin` 统一产生；
23:   - 错误一律 `app.core.errors` 的 `DomainError` 子类 + `code` 参数；

1: """不透明游标编解码。
2: 
3: 游标只承载排序键，前端不得解析；编码使用 urlsafe base64，避免 URL 转义问题。
4: 
5: 调用方直接把 ORM 字段放进 payload（``last.id`` 是 ``UUID``、``created_at`` 是
6: ``datetime``）。``json.dumps`` 不认识这些类型，历史上会抛 ``TypeError`` 并被
7: 全局异常处理成 500——只要列表需要返回 ``next_cursor`` 就会触发。因此编码层统一
8: 做 JSON-safe 归一化：``UUID`` 转标准字符串、``datetime`` 转 ISO 8601，解码后由
9: 各业务的游标判断再用 ``uuid.UUID(...)`` / ``datetime.fromisoformat(...)`` 还原。
10: """
11: 
12: from __future__ import annotations
13: 
14: import base64
15: import json
16: import uuid
17: from datetime import date, datetime
18: from typing import Any
19: 
20: from app.core.errors import ValidationFailedError
21: 
22: 
23: def _json_safe(value: Any) -> str:
24:     """把游标值转成确定的字符串表示，避免依赖隐式 ``str()``。"""
25:     if isinstance(value, uuid.UUID):
26:         return str(value)
27:     if isinstance(value, datetime):
28:         return value.isoformat()
29:     if isinstance(value, date):
30:         return value.isoformat()
31:     raise TypeError(f"游标值不可序列化：{type(value).__name__}")
32: 
33: 
34: def encode_cursor(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
35:     raw = json.dumps(
36:         payload,
37:         ensure_ascii=False,
38:         separators=(",", ":"),
39:         default=_json_safe,
40:     ).encode()
41:     return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(raw).decode().rstrip("=")
42: 
43: 
44: def decode_cursor(cursor: str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
45:     if not cursor:
46:         return {}
47:     padded = cursor + "=" * (-len(cursor) % 4)
48:     try:
49:         data = json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(padded.encode()))
50:     except (ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
51:         raise ValidationFailedError("分页游标无效") from exc
52:     if not isinstance(data, dict):
53:         raise ValidationFailedError("分页游标无效")
54:     return data

1: """统一错误信封与领域异常。
2: 
3: HTTP 边界只做一件事：把 ``DomainError`` 转成
4: ``{"error": {"code", "message", "request_id"}}``，避免各模块自己拼响应体。
5: """
6: 
7: from __future__ import annotations
8: 
9: import logging
10: import uuid
11: from contextvars import ContextVar
12: from typing import Any
13: 
14: from fastapi import FastAPI, Request
15: from fastapi.exceptions import RequestValidationError
16: from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
17: from sqlalchemy.exc import InterfaceError, OperationalError
18: from starlette.exceptions import HTTPException as StarletteHTTPException
19: 
20: logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
21: 
22: # 每个请求一个 ID，错误响应、日志与响应头共用。
23: request_id_ctx: ContextVar[str] = ContextVar("request_id", default="")
24: 
25: 
26: def current_request_id() -> str:
27:     return request_id_ctx.get() or "unknown"
28: 
29: 
30: def request_id_from(request: Request) -> str:
31:     """读取当前请求 ID。
32: 
33:     ``contextvar`` 在正常请求链路中最快，但未处理异常会越过
34:     ``RequestContextMiddleware``（其 ``finally`` 已复位 contextvar）后才由最外层
35:     ``ServerErrorMiddleware`` 处理，此时只能从 ``request.state`` 取。
36:     """
37:     value = getattr(request.state, "request_id", "")
38:     return value or current_request_id()
39: 
40: 
41: class DomainError(Exception):
42:     """可预期的业务异常，必须由 HTTP 层统一转换。"""
43: 
44:     status_code: int = 400
45:     code: str = "bad_request"
46: 
47:     def __init__(
48:         self,
49:         message: str,
50:         *,
51:         code: str | None = None,
52:         status_code: int | None = None,
53:         details: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
54:     ) -> None:
55:         super().__init__(message)
56:         self.message = message
57:         if code is not None:
58:             self.code = code
59:         if status_code is not None:
60:             self.status_code = status_code
61:         self.details = details or {}
62: 
63:     def to_envelope(self, request_id: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
64:         error: dict[str, Any] = {
65:             "code": self.code,
66:             "message": self.message,
67:             "request_id": request_id or current_request_id(),
68:         }
69:         # details 是向后兼容的扩展字段：前端契约只读 code/message/request_id，
70:         # 需要携带 run_id 等结构化信息时放在 details 里，避免破坏信封形状。
71:         if self.details:
72:             error["details"] = self.details
73:         return {"error": error}
74: 
75: 
76: class BadRequestError(DomainError):
77:     status_code = 400
78:     code = "bad_request"
79: 
80: 
81: class UnauthorizedError(DomainError):
82:     status_code = 401
83:     code = "unauthorized"

from app.core.deps import CurrentUser, DbSession

    ConversationCreateRequest,

router = APIRouter(prefix="/conversations", tags=["会话"])


@router.get("", response_model=ConversationPage)
async def list_conversations(
    user: CurrentUser,
    db: DbSession,
    q: str | None = Query(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=100),
    status_filter: Literal["active", "archived", "all"] = Query(default="all", alias="status"),
    limit: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=100),

"""ORM 公共 Mixin：UUID 主键与审计时间。"""

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from datetime import datetime

from sqlalchemy import DateTime, func
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column


class UUIDPrimaryKeyMixin:
    id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4)


class TimestampMixin:
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(
        DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), nullable=False
    )
    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(
        DateTime(timezone=True),
        server_default=func.now(),
        onupdate=func.now(),
        nullable=False,
    )

"""审计日志（M1.5 起写入，本阶段先建表）。"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import BigInteger, DateTime, Identity, Index, String, func, text
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import INET, JSONB
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column

from app.db.base import Base


class AuditLog(Base):
    __tablename__ = "audit_logs"
    __table_args__ = (
        Index("ix_audit_logs_created", text("created_at DESC")),
        Index("ix_audit_logs_actor_created", "actor_id", text("created_at DESC")),
        Index("ix_audit_logs_action_created", "action", text("created_at DESC")),
    )

    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(BigInteger, Identity(), primary_key=True)
    actor_type: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(16), nullable=False)
    actor_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), nullable=False, default="", server_default="")
    action: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), nullable=False)
    resource_type: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        String(64), nullable=False, default="", server_default=""
    )
    resource_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        String(64), nullable=False, default="", server_default=""
    )
    detail: Mapped[dict[str, Any]] = mapped_column(
        JSONB, nullable=False, default=dict, server_default=text("'{}'::jsonb")
    )
    request_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        String(64), nullable=False, default="", server_default=""
    )
    ip: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(INET, nullable=True)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(
        DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), nullable=False
    )

"""异步数据库引擎与会话工厂。

引擎懒加载，避免 import 阶段连接数据库（测试可以替换配置后首次使用）。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import AsyncIterator
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import (
    AsyncEngine,
    AsyncSession,
    async_sessionmaker,
    create_async_engine,
)

from app.core.config import get_settings

_engine: AsyncEngine | None = None
_session_factory: async_sessionmaker[AsyncSession] | None = None


def get_engine() -> AsyncEngine:
    global _engine
    if _engine is None:
        settings = get_settings()
        kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {
            "echo": settings.db_echo,
            "pool_pre_ping": settings.db_pool_pre_ping,
        }
        # SQLite 测试时不支持连接池参数；生产默认走 PostgreSQL。
        if not settings.database_url.startswith("sqlite"):
            kwargs["pool_size"] = settings.db_pool_size
            kwargs["max_overflow"] = settings.db_max_overflow
            # 契约要求时间统一返回 UTC；把数据库会话时区固定为 UTC，
            # 避免 timestamptz 按本机时区返回 +08:00。
            kwargs["connect_args"] = {"options": "-c timezone=UTC"}
        _engine = create_async_engine(settings.database_url, **kwargs)
    return _engine


def get_session_factory() -> async_sessionmaker[AsyncSession]:
    global _session_factory
    if _session_factory is None:
        _session_factory = async_sessionmaker(
            bind=get_engine(), expire_on_commit=False, autoflush=False
        )
    return _session_factory


async def get_db() -> AsyncIterator[AsyncSession]:
    """FastAPI 依赖：每个请求一个会话，异常时回滚。"""
    factory = get_session_factory()
    async with factory() as session:
        try:
            yield session
        except Exception:
            await session.rollback()
            raise

```python
def _build_filters(q: str | None, role: str | None, status: str | None) -> list[Any]:
    filters: list[Any] = []
    if q:
        pattern = f"%{_escape_like(q)}%"
        filters.append(or_(User.email.ilike(pattern, escape="\\"), User.display_name.ilike(pattern, escape="\\")))
    if role:

    if status:
        filters.append(User.status == status)
    return filters
```

    disabled = await _create_user_row(db, status="disabled", display_name="停用用户")

    response = await client.get("/api/v1/admin/users", headers=admin_auth)
    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
    body = response.json()
    assert body["stats"] == {"total": 3, "active": 2, "disabled": 1, "admins": 1}
    assert body["has_more"] is False
    assert body["next_cursor"] is None
    assert {item["id"] for item in body["items"]} == {
        str(admin.id),
        str(user.id),
        str(disabled.id),
    }

    by_role = await client.get(
        "/api/v1/admin/users", params={"role": "user"}, headers=admin_auth
    )
    assert by_role.status_code == 200, by_role.text
    role_body = by_role.json()
    assert {item["id"] for item in role_body["items"]} == {str(user.id), str(disabled.id)}
    assert all(item["role"] == "user" for item in role_body["items"])
    # stats 是当前筛选条件下的计数：role=user 时管理员数为 0。
    assert role_body["stats"] == {"total": 2, "active": 1, "disabled": 1, "admins": 0}

    by_status = await client.get(
        "/api/v1/admin/users", params={"status": "disabled"}, headers=admin_auth
    )
    assert by_status.status_code == 200, by_status.text
    status_body = by_status.json()
    assert [item["id"] for item in status_body["items"]] == [str(disabled.id)]
    assert status_body["stats"] == {"total": 1, "active": 0, "disabled": 1, "admins": 0}

    by_email = await client.get(
        "/api/v1/admin/users",
        params={"q": user.email.split("@")[0]},
        headers=admin_auth,
    )
    assert by_email.status_code == 200, by_email.text
    assert [item["id"] for item in by_email.json()["items"]] == [str(user.id)]

    by_name = await client.get(
        "/api/v1/admin/users", params={"q": "停用"}, headers=admin_auth
    )
    assert by_name.status_code == 200, by_name.text
    assert [item["id"] for item in by_name.json()["items"]] == [str(disabled.id)]

    first = await client.get(
        "/api/v1/admin/users", params={"limit": 1}, headers=admin_auth
    )
    assert first.status_code == 200, first.text
    first_body = first.json()
    assert len(first_body["items"]) == 1
    assert first_body["has_more"] is True
    assert first_body["next_cursor"]
    seen = [first_body["items"][0]["id"]]
    cursor = first_body["next_cursor"]
    # 连续翻页直到结束，确认游标不重复、不漏项。
    for _ in range(5):
        page = await client.get(
            "/api/v1/admin/users",
            params={"limit": 1, "cursor": cursor},
            headers=admin_auth,
        )
        assert page.status_code == 200, page.text
        page_body = page.json()
        seen.extend(item["id"] for item in page_body["items"])
        if not page_body["has_more"]:
            assert page_body["next_cursor"] is None
            break
        cursor = page_body["next_cursor"]
    assert len(seen) == 3
    assert len(set(seen)) == 3

}


```python
async def _create_user_row(
    db: AsyncSession,
    *,
    role: str = "user",
    status: str = "active",
    display_name: str = "测试用户",
    email: str | None = None,
) -> User:
```
    """直接落库造用户（比走注册接口更可控），提交后返回已刷新行。"""
    row = User(
        email=email or f"{role}-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}@example.com",
        password_hash=hash_password("password123"),
        display_name=display_name,
        role=role,
        status=status,
    )
    db.add(row)
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(row)
    return row


def _user_headers(user: User) -> dict[str, str]:

async def test_list_users_filters_stats_and_cursor(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient,
    admin: User,
    admin_auth: dict[str, str],
    user: User,
    db: AsyncSession,
) -> None:
    """默认列表、stats、role/status/q 过滤与游标翻页。"""
    disabled = await _create_user_row(db, status="disabled", display_name="停用用户")

    response = await client.get("/api/v1/admin/users", headers=admin_auth)
    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
    body = response.json()
    assert body["stats"] == {"total": 3, "active": 2, "disabled": 1, "admins": 1}
    assert body["has_more"] is False
    assert body["next_cursor"] is None
    assert {item["id"] for item in body["items"]} == {
        str(admin.id),
        str(user.id),
        str(disabled.id),
    }

    by_role = await client.get(
        "/api/v1/admin/users", params={"role": "user"}, headers=admin_auth
    )
    assert by_role.status_code == 200, by_role.text
    role_body = by_role.json()
    assert {item["id"] for item in role_body["items"]} == {str(user.id), str(disabled.id)}
    assert all(item["role"] == "user" for item in role_body["items"])
    # stats 是当前筛选条件下的计数：role=user 时管理员数为 0。
    assert role_body["stats"] == {"total": 2, "active": 1, "disabled": 1, "admins": 0}

    by_status = await client.get(
        "/api/v1/admin/users", params={"status": "disabled"}, headers=admin_auth
    )
    assert by_status.status_code == 200, by_status.text
    status_body = by_status.json()
    assert [item["id"] for item in status_body["items"]] == [str(disabled.id)]
    assert status_body["stats"] == {"total": 1, "active": 0, "disabled": 1, "admins": 0}

    by_email = await client.get(
        "/api/v1/admin/users",
        params={"q": user.email.split("@")[0]},
        headers=admin_auth,
    )
    assert by_email.status_code == 200, by_email.text
    assert [item["id"] for item in by_email.json()["items"]] == [str(user.id)]

    by_name = await client.get(
        "/api/v1/admin/users", params={"q": "停用"}, headers=admin_auth
    )
    assert by_name.status_code == 200, by_name.text
    assert [item["id"] for item in by_name.json()["items"]] == [str(disabled.id)]

    first = await client.get(
        "/api/v1/admin/users", params={"limit": 1}, headers=admin_auth
    )
    assert first.status_code == 200, first.text
    first_body = first.json()
    assert len(first_body["items"]) == 1
    assert first_body["has_more"] is True
    assert first_body["next_cursor"]
    seen = [first_body["items"][0]["id"]]
    cursor = first_body["next_cursor"]
    # 连续翻页直到结束，确认游标不重复、不漏项。
    for _ in range(5):
        page = await client.get(
            "/api/v1/admin/users",
            params={"limit": 1, "cursor": cursor},
            headers=admin_auth,
        )
        assert page.status_code == 200, page.text
        page_body = page.json()
        seen.extend(item["id"] for item in page_body["items"])
        if not page_body["has_more"]:
            assert page_body["next_cursor"] is None
            break
        cursor = page_body["next_cursor"]
    assert len(seen) == 3
    assert len(set(seen)) == 3

{"content": """"管理台用户管理业务：列表/详情/角色与状态更新。

唯一新增的管理台业务 SQL 都在这里：列表按 ``created_at DESC, id DESC`` 游标分页，
``stats`` 用一次聚合查询按当前筛选条件计数；PATCH 负责自操作与「最后一个活跃
管理员」保护，并在真实变更时写 ``admin.user.update`` 审计。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import and_, func, or_, select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.audit import write_audit
from app.core.cursor import decode_cursor, encode_cursor
from app.core.errors import ConflictError, NotFoundError, ValidationFailedError
from app.db.models.user import User
from app.modules.admin.schemas import (
    AdminUserOut,
    AdminUserPage,
    AdminUserPatchRequest,
    AdminUserStats,
)


def _escape_like(value: str) -> str:
    """转义 LIKE 通配符，避免 ``q`` 里的 %/_/\\ 扩大匹配范围。"""
    return value.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("%", "\\%").replace("_", "\\_")


def _to_out(user: User) -> AdminUserOut:
    return AdminUserOut(
        id=user.id,
        email=user.email,
        display_name=user.display_name,
        role=user.role,
        status=user.status,
        last_login_at=user.last_login_at,
        created_at=user.created_at,
        updated_at=user.updated_at,
    )


def _build_filters(
    q: str | None, role: str | None, status: str | None
) -> list[Any]:
    """按 q/role/status 组装筛选条件；游标条件单独追加，不进入 stats。"""
    filters: list[Any] = []
    if q:
        pattern = f"%{_escape_like(q)}%"
        filters.append(
            or_(
                User.email.ilike(pattern, escape="\\"),
                User.display_name.ilike(pattern, escape="\\"),
            )
        )
    if role:
        filters.append(User.role == role)
    if status:
        filters.append(User.status == status)
    return filters


async def _user_stats(db: AsyncSession, filters: list[Any]) -> AdminUserStats:
    stmt = select(
        func.count(User.id).label("total"),
        func.count(User.id).filter(User.status == "active").label("active"),
        func.count(User.id).filter(User.status == "disabled").label("disabled"),
        func.count(User.id).filter(User.role == "admin").label("admins"),
    ).where(*filters)
    row = (await db.execute(stmt)).one()
    return AdminUserStats(
        total=int(row.total),
        active=int(row.active),
        disabled=int(row.disabled),
        admins=int(row.admins),
    )


async def list_users(
    db: AsyncSession,
    *,
    q: str | None,
    role: str | None,
    status: str | None,
    limit: int,
    cursor: str | None,
) -> AdminUserPage:
    filters = _build_filters(q, role, status)

    decoded = decode_cursor(cursor)
    if cursor:
        raw_created_at = decoded.get("created_at")
        raw_id = decoded.get("id")
        if raw_created_at is None or raw_id is None:
            raise ValidationFailedError("分页游标无效")
        try:
            last_created_at = datetime.fromisoformat(str(raw_created_at))
            last_id = uuid.UUID(str(raw_id))
        except (ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
            raise ValidationFailedError("分页游标无效") from exc
        filters.append(
            or_(
                User.created_at < last_created_at,
                and_(
                    User.created_at == last_created_at,
                    User.id < last_id,
                ),
            )
        )

    stmt = (
        select(User)
        .where(*filters)
        .order_by(User.created_at.desc(), User.id.desc())
        .limit(limit + 1)
    )
    rows = list((await db.execute(stmt)).scalars())
    has_more = len(rows) > limit
    rows = rows[:limit]

    next_cursor = None
    if has_more and rows:
        last = rows[-1]
        next_cursor = encode_cursor({"created_at": last.created_at, "id": last.id})

    stats = await _user_stats(db, _build_filters(q, role, status))
    return AdminUserPage(
        items=[_to_out(row) for row in rows],
        next_cursor=next_cursor,
        has_more=has_more,
        stats=stats,
    )


async def get_user(db: AsyncSession, user_id: uuid.UUID) -> AdminUserOut:
    user = await db.get(User, user_id)
    if user is None:
        raise NotFoundError("用户不存在")
    return _to_out(user)


async def update_user(
    db: AsyncSession,
    admin: User,
    user_id: uuid.UUID,
    payload: AdminUserPatchRequest,
) -> AdminUserOut:
    target = await db.get(User, user_id)
    if target is None:
        raise NotFoundError("用户不存在")

    # 只统计实际变化的字段：同值 PATCH 是 no-op，不写审计。
    changed: set[str] = set()
    if payload.role is not None and payload.role != target.role:
        changed.add("role")
    if payload.status is not None and payload.status != target.status:
        changed.add("status")
    if not changed:
        return _to_out(target)

    # 自操作规则优先于最后管理员保护，返回 422 而不是静默成功。
    if target.id == admin.id and "role" in changed:
        raise ValidationFailedError(
            "不能修改自己的角色", code="cannot_change_own_role"
        )
    if target.id == admin.id and payload.status == "disabled":
        raise ValidationFailedError("不能停用自己的账号", code="cannot_disable_self")

    # 把活跃管理员降级或停用前，先按 id ASC 锁住全部活跃管理员行：固定加锁顺序
    # 防死锁，锁后 refresh 目标再计算剩余数量，防两个管理员并发互相降级。
    demote_or_disable_active_admin = (
        target.role == "admin"
        and target.status == "active"
        and (payload.role == "user" or payload.status == "disabled")
    )
    if demote_or_disable_active_admin:
        locked_ids = list(
            (
                await db.execute(
                    select(User.id)
                    .where(User.role == "admin", User.status == "active")
                    .order_by(User.id)
                    .with_for_update()
                )
            ).scalars()
        )
        await db.refresh(target)
        remaining = len(locked_ids) - (1 if target.id in locked_ids else 0)
        if target.role == "admin" and target.status == "active" and remaining == 0:
            raise ConflictError(
                "不能移除最后一个活跃管理员",
                code="last_admin_protected",
                details={"active_admins": 1},
            )

    if payload.role is not None:
        target.role = payload.role
    if payload.status is not None:
        target.status = payload.status

    await write_audit(
        db,
        actor_type="user",
        actor_id=str(admin.id),
        action="admin.user.update",
        resource_type="user",
        resource_id=str(target.id),
        detail={
            "fields": sorted(changed),
            "role": target.role,
            "status": target.status,
        },
    )
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(target)
    return _to_out(target)


__all__ = ["get_user", "list_users", "update_user"]

唯一新增的管理台业务 SQL 都在这里：列表按 ``created_at DESC, id DESC`` 游标分页，
``stats`` 用一次聚合查询按当前筛选条件计数；PATCH 负责自操作与「最后一个活跃
管理员」保护，并在真实变更时写 ``admin.user.update`` 审计。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import and_, func, or_, select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.audit import write_audit
from app.core.cursor import decode_cursor, encode_cursor
from app.core.errors import ConflictError, NotFoundError, ValidationFailedError
from app.db.models.user import User
from app.modules.admin.schemas import (
    AdminUserOut,
    AdminUserPage,
    AdminUserPatchRequest,
    AdminUserStats,
)


def _escape_like(value: str) -> str:
    """转义 LIKE 通配符，避免 ``q`` 里的 %/_/\\ 扩大匹配范围。"""
    return value.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("%", "\\%").replace("_", "\\_")


def _to_out(user: User) -> AdminUserOut:
    return AdminUserOut(
        id=user.id,
        email=user.email,
        display_name=user.display_name,
        role=user.role,
        status=user.status,
        last_login_at=user.last_login_at,
        created_at=user.created_at,
        updated_at=user.updated_at,
    )


def _build_filters(
    q: str | None, role: str | None, status: str | None
) -> list[Any]:
    """按 q/role/status 组装筛选条件；游标条件单独追加，不进入 stats。"""
    filters: list[Any] = []
    if q:
        pattern = f"%{_escape_like(q)}%"
        filters.append(
            or_(
                User.email.ilike(pattern, escape="\\"),
                User.display_name.ilike(pattern, escape="\\"),
            )
        )
    if role:
        filters.append(User.role == role)
    if status:
        filters.append(User.status == status)
    return filters


async def _user_stats(db: AsyncSession, filters: list[Any]) -> AdminUserStats:
    stmt = select(
        func.count(User.id).label("total"),
        func.count(User.id).filter(User.status == "active").label("active"),
        func.count(User.id).filter(User.status == "disabled").label("disabled"),
        func.count(User.id).filter(User.role == "admin").label("admins"),
    ).where(*filters)
    row = (await db.execute(stmt)).one()
    return AdminUserStats(
        total=int(row.total),
        active=int(row.active),
        disabled=int(row.disabled),
        admins=int(row.admins),
    )


async def list_users(
    db: AsyncSession,
    *,
    q: str | None,
    role: str | None,
    status: str | None,
    limit: int,
    cursor: str | None,
) -> AdminUserPage:
    filters = _build_filters(q, role, status)

    decoded = decode_cursor(cursor)
    if cursor:
        raw_created_at = decoded.get("created_at")
        raw_id = decoded.get("id")
        if raw_created_at is None or raw_id is None:
            raise ValidationFailedError("分页游标无效")
        try:
            last_created_at = datetime.fromisoformat(str(raw_created_at))
            last_id = uuid.UUID(str(raw_id))
        except (ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
            raise ValidationFailedError("分页游标无效") from exc
        filters.append(
            or_(
                User.created_at < last_created_at,
                and_(
                    User.created_at == last_created_at,
                    User.id < last_id,
                ),
            )
        )

    stmt = (
        select(User)
        .where(*filters)
        .order_by(User.created_at.desc(), User.id.desc())
        .limit(limit + 1)
    )
    rows = list((await db.execute(stmt)).scalars())
    has_more = len(rows) > limit
    rows = rows[:limit]

    next_cursor = None
    if has_more and rows:
        last = rows[-1]
        next_cursor = encode_cursor({"created_at": last.created_at, "id": last.id})

    stats = await _user_stats(db, _build_filters(q, role, status))
    return AdminUserPage(
        items=[_to_out(row) for row in rows],
        next_cursor=next_cursor,
        has_more=has_more,
        stats=stats,
    )


async def get_user(db: AsyncSession, user_id: uuid.UUID) -> AdminUserOut:
    user = await db.get(User, user_id)
    if user is None:
        raise NotFoundError("用户不存在")
    return _to_out(user)


async def update_user(
    db: AsyncSession,
    admin: User,
    user_id: uuid.UUID,
    payload: AdminUserPatchRequest,
) -> AdminUserOut:
    target = await db.get(User, user_id)
    if target is None:
        raise NotFoundError("用户不存在")

    # 只统计实际变化的字段：同值 PATCH 是 no-op，不写审计。
    changed: set[str] = set()
    if payload.role is not None and payload.role != target.role:
        changed.add("role")
    if payload.status is not None and payload.status != target.status:
        changed.add("status")
    if not changed:
        return _to_out(target)

    # 自操作规则优先于最后管理员保护，返回 422 而不是静默成功。
    if target.id == admin.id and "role" in changed:
        raise ValidationFailedError(
            "不能修改自己的角色", code="cannot_change_own_role"
        )
    if target.id == admin.id and payload.status == "disabled":
        raise ValidationFailedError("不能停用自己的账号", code="cannot_disable_self")

    # 把活跃管理员降级或停用前，先按 id ASC 锁住全部活跃管理员行：固定加锁顺序
    # 防死锁，锁后 refresh 目标再计算剩余数量，防两个管理员并发互相降级。
    demote_or_disable_active_admin = (
        target.role == "admin"
        and target.status == "active"
        and (payload.role == "user" or payload.status == "disabled")
    )
    if demote_or_disable_active_admin:
        locked_ids = list(
            (
                await db.execute(
                    select(User.id)
                    .where(User.role == "admin", User.status == "active")
                    .order_by(User.id)
                    .with_for_update()
                )
            ).scalars()
        )
        await db.refresh(target)
        remaining = len(locked_ids) - (1 if target.id in locked_ids else 0)
        if target.role == "admin" and target.status == "active" and remaining == 0:
            raise ConflictError(
                "不能移除最后一个活跃管理员",
                code="last_admin_protected",
                details={"active_admins": 1},
            )

    if payload.role is not None:
        target.role = payload.role
    if payload.status is not None:
        target.status = payload.status

    await write_audit(
        db,
        actor_type="user",
        actor_id=str(admin.id),
        action="admin.user.update",
        resource_type="user",
        resource_id=str(target.id),
        detail={
            "fields": sorted(changed),
            "role": target.role,
            "status": target.status,
        },
    )
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(target)
    return _to_out(target)

```python

...
```
But the ordering of queries: plan says stats extra query; could compute stats first (before pagination) using same filters, then append cursor filters. Let me restructure for cleanliness: build filters once, `stats = await _user_stats(db, filters)` before appending cursor condition. Then append. Actually then stats query happens before list query — fine. Or copy: `list_filters = [*filters, cursor_condition]`. Simpler: keep base filters and build `list_filters`. Let me revise to avoid duplicate calls:

```python

stats = await _user_stats(db, filters)
# cursor appended to filters for the page query
```

Hmm, but then stats is fetched even if cursor invalid? No — cursor parsed before stats if placed after. Let me order: build filters; parse cursor & append; but need base filters for stats — duplicates avoided by computing stats on `_build_filters(...)` again as now. It's a function call, cheap. But reviewers may flag redundancy. Alternative:

```python
base_filters = _build_filters(q, role, status)
stats = await _user_stats(db, base_filters)
list_filters = list(base_filters)
... append cursor to list_filters
stmt = select(User).where(*list_filters)
```
Then stats query happens before cursor validation... invalid cursor should 422 regardless of an extra query, no problem. But plan says invalid cursor → 422; stats query executed needlessly before raising is a slight waste but fine. However, ordering might matter if hidden test checks something? No.

Better: parse cursor first (without filters), then base_filters, stats, append. Structure:

```python
cursor_filter = _cursor_filter(cursor)  # returns expression or None, raises
filters = _build_filters(...)
stats = await _user_stats(db, filters)
page_filters = [*filters, cursor_filter] if cursor_filter is not None else filters
```

{"content": "# M8 Task 1 交付报告：管理台路由骨架 + 用户列表/详情/PATCH

- 日期：2026-11-11
- 任务：`.superpowers/sdd/2026-11-11-m8-admin-console/task-1-brief.md`
- 计划：`docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-11-m8-admin-console.md` §Global Constraints / §契约总览 / Task 1
- 结论：**完成**。3 个 `/api/v1/admin/users*` 端点按契约落地，10 条集成测试全绿，全量回归 770 passed / 1 skipped，ruff 全绿，无迁移、未改文档与其他模块。
- 提交：`d2b6680 feat: 管理台用户列表/详情/PATCH 与路由骨架（M8 Task 1）`（仅本地，未推送）

## 1. 前置检查（M7-2 依赖）

```text
$ grep -n "required_role" app/core/deps.py
56:                    "required_role": "admin",
73:        raise ForbiddenError("需要管理员权限", details={"required_role": "admin"})

$ grep -rn "security.rbac_denied" app
app/core/deps.py:50:                action="security.rbac_denied",
```

M7 RBAC 门禁与拒绝审计已落地，本任务直接消费 `AdminUser` / `DbSession`，未重复实现 M7 范围。

## 2. 变更文件（提交内容，共 6 文件 +787 行）

| 文件 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `app/modules/admin/__init__.py` | 新增包声明 |
| `app/modules/admin/schemas.py` | 新增 `AdminUserOut` / `AdminUserStats` / `AdminUserPage` / `AdminUserPatchRequest` |
| `app/modules/admin/service.py` | 新增用户列表/详情/更新业务（唯一新增业务 SQL） |
| `app/modules/admin/router.py` | 新增 `router = APIRouter(prefix="/admin", tags=["管理台"])`，本任务含 3 个用户端点，供 T2–T6 追加 |
| `app/api/v1/router.py` | 修改：`include_router(admin_router, responses=COMMON_ERROR_RESPONSES)` |
| `tests/integration/test_admin_users.py` | 新增 10 条集成测试 |

未修改：`app/db/models/`、`alembic/versions/`（**无迁移**，只用既有 `users.role/status` 等列）、`docs/`、`docs/openapi.json`、其他业务模块。

## 3. 端点与契约

### 3.1 `GET /api/v1/admin/users`

- 参数：`q`（`max_length=100`，`email`/`display_name` 大小写不敏感 ilike，转义 `%`/`_`/`\`）、`role`（`user|admin`）、`status`（`active|disabled`）、`limit`（1–100，默认 20）、`cursor`（`max_length=500`）。
- 排序：`created_at DESC, id DESC`；`limit+1` 判断 `has_more`。
- 游标：payload `{"created_at": <datetime ISO>, "id": <UUID>}`；解码失败、字段缺失、时间/UUID 非法 → 422 `validation_error`（"分页游标无效"）。
- `stats`：当前 `q/role/status` 筛选条件下的全量计数（不含游标），一次聚合查询：
  `total` / `active` / `disabled` / `admins`（`count(*) FILTER (WHERE ...)`）。
- 响应：`AdminUserPage{items, next_cursor, has_more, stats}`；`items` 与详情同形。

### 3.2 `GET /api/v1/admin/users/{user_id}`

- 200 `AdminUserOut`：`id/email/display_name/role/status/last_login_at/created_at/updated_at`；**永远不含 `password_hash`**。
- 不存在 → 404 `not_found`（"用户不存在"）。
- 不带活动计数（R6）。

### 3.3 `PATCH /api/v1/admin/users/{user_id}`

- 请求体 `{role?, status?}`：`extra="forbid"`、至少一项非 None，否则 422 `validation_error`。
- 规则执行顺序（`service.update_user`）：
  1. 目标不存在 → 404 `not_found`；
  2. 计算实际变化字段；无变化 → 200 返回当前值、**不写审计、不提交**；
  3. 改自己角色 → 422 `cannot_change_own_role`（"不能修改自己的角色"）；
  4. 停用自己 → 422 `cannot_disable_self`（"不能停用自己的账号"）；
  5. 把「活跃管理员」降为 `user` 或停用前，执行 `SELECT id FROM users WHERE role='admin' AND status='active' ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE`，随后 `db.refresh(target)`，按锁后结果与 `remaining = len(locked_ids) - (1 if target.id in locked_ids else 0)` 判定；目标仍是活跃管理员且 `remaining == 0` → 409 `last_admin_protected`（"不能移除最后一个活跃管理员"，`details={"active_admins": 1}`）；
  6. 应用变更，`write_audit(actor_type="user", actor_id=str(admin.id), action="admin.user.update", resource_type="user", resource_id=str(target.id), detail={"fields": sorted(changed), "role": target.role, "status": target.status})`，`await db.commit()`、`await db.refresh(target)` 后返回 `AdminUserOut`。
- 固定 `id ASC` 加锁顺序防死锁；行锁 + 锁后 refresh 防两个管理员并发互降。

### 3.4 权限

- 3 个端点均使用 `AdminUser` + `DbSession`：未登录 401 `unauthorized`；非管理员 403 `forbidden` + `details.required_role="admin"`（M7 `require_admin` 统一产生并写 `security.rbac_denied` 审计）。
- OpenAPI 通过 `COMMON_ERROR_RESPONSES` 注入 400/401/403/404/409/413/422/429/500/503 描述。

## 4. TDD 证据

### 4.1 RED（先写测试）

```text
E   ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'app.modules.admin'
!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Interrupted: 1 error during collection !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
=============================== 1 error in 0.43s ===============================
```

### 4.2 GREEN（实现后，含最终补强断言）

```text
$ TEST_DATABASE_URL=... .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/integration/test_admin_users.py -v
tests/integration/test_admin_users.py::test_list_users_filters_stats_and_cursor PASSED

```

## 5. 测试覆盖（10 条，对照 brief Step 2 全覆盖 + 2 条补强）

| 用例 | 覆盖点 |
|---|---|
| `test_list_users_filters_stats_and_cursor` | 默认列表、精确 `stats`、`role`/`status`/`q`(邮箱片段+展示名片段) 过滤、筛选后 stats 口径、`limit=1` 翻页 `has_more`/`next_cursor`、连续翻页无重复 |
| `test_q_escapes_like_wildcards` | `%`/`_` 被转义，不会匹配全部用户 |
| `test_get_user_detail_and_not_found` | 详情字段全集、无 `password_hash`、GET 404、**PATCH 不存在用户 404** |
| `test_patch_role_status_and_audit` | 降级第二个管理员、停用普通用户、同值 PATCH 200 且不写审计、审计 `action/actor/fields/role/status` 精确断言 |
| `test_cannot_change_own_role` | 422 `cannot_change_own_role`，库中 role 仍 admin |
| `test_cannot_disable_self` | 422 `cannot_disable_self`，库中 status 仍 active |
| `test_last_active_admin_is_protected` | 服务层用普通用户对象作 actor，`ConflictError.code=last_admin_protected`、409、`details.active_admins=1`，rollback 后 admin 未变 |
| `test_can_disable_other_admin_when_another_active_admin_remains` | 守卫不误伤合法操作（当前管理员仍活跃） |
| `test_non_admin_forbidden_and_unauthorized` | 3 端点均 403 `forbidden` + `details.required_role=="admin"`（PATCH 带合法 body）；无 token 均 401 `unauthorized` |
| `test_invalid_cursor_and_patch_validation` | 非法游标 + 缺字段/坏时间/坏 UUID 游标 422；`PATCH {}`/`{"display_name":"x"}`/`{"role":null}` 422；非法 `role/status` 枚举与 `limit=0/101` 422 |

夹具：`client`、`admin`、`admin_auth`、`user`、`db`（会话用于直接造第二个管理员/停用用户/查库校验），`auth_headers` 签发普通用户 token。未引用未定义的 `registered` dict。

## 6. 验证结果

| 检查 | 命令 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| 目标测试 | `TEST_DATABASE_URL=... pytest tests/integration/test_admin_users.py -q`（测试库 `agent_hub_test`） | `10 passed in 3.59s` |
| 全量回归 | `TEST_DATABASE_URL=... .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q` | **`770 passed, 1 skipped in 112.64s`**（基线 760 + 新增 10；1 skipped 为既有 skip，非本任务） |
| Lint | `.venv/bin/python -m ruff check .` | `All checks passed!` |
| OpenAPI 冒烟 | `app.openapi()` | 3 个 admin 用户操作均生成 200 + 通用错误响应；`AdminUserOut` 无 `password_hash`；PATCH schema `additionalProperties: false` |
| 迁移 | — | 未新增/修改 `alembic/versions/`，未改模型 |

## 7. 自审

- **契约逐项对照**：路径、参数名、枚举值、默认值/范围、422/404/409 码值与中文消息、审计 `action="admin.user.update"` 与 detail 键名均与 brief/plan 一致，未自造命名。
- **R2**：PATCH 只改 `role/status`，`email/display_name/password` 不在可改范围（extra forbid 拒绝）。
- **R3**：自改角色 422、自停用 422；同值自 PATCH 是 200 no-op（不算"修改"）。
- **R4**：最后管理员 409 `last_admin_protected` + `details={"active_admins": 1}`。
- **R6**：详情与列表项同形，不带会话/消息/活动计数。
- **R10**：审计动作固定 `admin.user.update`，detail 只放字段名与状态值，无正文/凭据/请求头。
- **并发**：固定 `id ASC` 的 `FOR UPDATE` 锁全部活跃管理员；锁后 `refresh(target)` 再计数。已按计划顺序实现。
- **无密钥/密文泄露**：响应 DTO 显式构造，不含 `password_hash`。
- **无副作用**：未改 `Settings`/`.env.example`/文档/OpenAPI 导出，未碰其他模块；未新增第三方依赖。
- **质量**：全部注释/docstring/summary/description 中文；ruff line-length 100 通过；分页用 `limit+1`；stats 为单次聚合、不拉 ORM 行。

## 8. 待同步文档点（T7 负责，本任务未改文档）

1. `docs/api.md` §2.12：用户三端点 `GET /admin/users`、`GET /admin/users/{user_id}`、`PATCH /admin/users/{user_id}` 的字段/参数/错误码（422 `cannot_change_own_role`/`cannot_disable_self`、409 `last_admin_protected` + `details.active_admins`）。
2. `docs/openapi.json` 重新导出（新增 3 个 admin 用户端点；T1 不导出，交由 T7 统一导出避免并行抢文件）。
3. 前端 handoff 需冻结：`AdminUserPage.stats` 为**当前筛选条件下**计数（含 `role/status` 过滤）；无变化 PATCH 返回 200 且不产生审计；403 显示无权限、401 刷新登录。
4. §7.6 分页：admin 用户列表游标 payload 形态 `{created_at, id}`（不透明串，前端不得解析）。

## 9. 关注点 / 已留意的边界

- **PATCH 锁后 changed 计算窗口**：变更集合在加锁前基于初次读取计算；加锁后仅 refresh 目标并重算 remaining，未重算 changed。并发场景下若目标在加锁前已被他人改为同值，本请求仍会按原 changed 写一次审计并提交（幂等更新）。这是计划 Step 5/6 字面顺序的实现；对「最后管理员保护」的正确性无影响（锁后按最新 role/status 判定）。若后续要求严格"零冗余审计"，可在 refresh 后重算 changed 再决定是否写审计。

- 请求体 `{role?, status?}`：`extra="forbid"`、至少一项非 None，否则 422 `validation_error`。

  1. 目标不存在 → 404 `not_found`；

- **契约逐项对照**：路径、参数名、枚举值、默认值/范围、422/404/409 码值与中文消息、审计 `action="admin.user.update"` 与 detail 键名均与 brief/plan 一致，未自造命名。

- **R3**：自改角色 422、自停用 422；同值自 PATCH 是 200 no-op（不算"修改"）。
- **R4**：最后管理员 409 `last_admin_protected` + `details={"active_admins": 1}`。
- **R6**：详情与列表项同形，不带会话/消息/活动计数。
- **R10**：审计动作固定 `admin.user.update`，detail 只放字段名与状态值，无正文/凭据/请求头。

tools.description: Create a scheduled task. At each occurrence of rrule, prompt is delivered to the target session as a scheduled message from the user. The result includes the task id and the next occurrence as scheduledAt in UTC and scheduledAtLocal in the zone of rrule. After downtime, only the latest missed occurrence is delivered. rrule.description: Supported RFC 5545 subset: one DTSTART line, a newline, and one RRULE line. DTSTART ends in Z for UTC or carries TZID with an IANA time zone; a fixed offset such as UTC+5 is Etc/GMT-5, with the sign reversed. DTSTART must name an existing local time. A TZID rule keeps local clock time across daylight-saving changes; generated nonexistent local times are skipped, and repeated ones occur once, at the earlier instant. DTSTART may be in the past; delivery starts with the first occurrence after creation. A one-time delivery is RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=1. No SECONDLY; BYSECOND takes one value. COUNT is at most 1000; use UNTIL for longer rules. MINUTELY and HOURLY accept no BY parts, so select clock times with DAILY or WEEKLY plus BYHOUR and BYMINUTE. BYMONTHDAY and ordinal BYDAY require MONTHLY or YEARLY; BYYEARDAY and BYWEEKNO require YEARLY. Ordinal BYDAY cannot combine with BYWEEKNO. Each FREQ period allows at most 10080 candidates before BYSETPOS, which accepts at most 31 values. UNTIL is a UTC instant ending in Z. Example: "DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Singapore:20260901T080000\nRRULE:FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR;BYSETPOS=-1"

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

content.text:
The user (lead) now asks for a fix round on HEAD `7de5202`. Let me start by checking the current git state, reading the relevant files, and planning.

This is a fairly large set of fixes. Let me organize:

**Important:**
1. `update_user` concurrency gap — always lock active admins + target row for any PATCH, recompute changed after lock, refresh target, recompute target_active/remaining, 409 if removing last active admin. Real concurrency tests with two independent AsyncSessions.

**Minor:**
1. `GET /admin/agents` stats cursor bug in `list_agents`: add `stats_ignore_cursor: bool = False` param; admin route passes True; test.
2. MCP create blank name: `McpServerCreateRequest._strip` after min_length → `"   "` becomes empty; add strip-after-nonempty validation. Docs handed to T7.
3. No-op audit semantics: instructions restore default with no row → no audit; skills same-value enable/disable no audit; MCP PATCH same value no audit and no `_check_and_sync` (compare all editable fields). Tests.

54: def _escape_like(value: str) -> str:

108: def _cursor_filter(cursor: str | None) -> Any | None:

111:         return None

176: async def update_user(
177:     db: AsyncSession,
178:     admin: User,
179:     user_id: uuid.UUID,
180:     payload: AdminUserPatchRequest,
181: ) -> AdminUserOut:
182:     target = await db.get(User, user_id)
183:     if target is None:
184:         raise NotFoundError("用户不存在")
185: 
186:     # 只统计实际变化的字段：同值 PATCH 是 no-op，不写审计。
187:     changed: set[str] = set()
188:     if payload.role is not None and payload.role != target.role:
189:         changed.add("role")
190:     if payload.status is not None and payload.status != target.status:
191:         changed.add("status")
192:     if not changed:
193:         return _to_out(target)
194: 
195:     # 自操作规则优先于最后管理员保护，返回 422 而不是静默成功。
196:     if target.id == admin.id and "role" in changed:
197:         raise ValidationFailedError(
198:             "不能修改自己的角色", code="cannot_change_own_role"
199:         )
200:     if target.id == admin.id and payload.status == "disabled":
201:         raise ValidationFailedError("不能停用自己的账号", code="cannot_disable_self")
202: 
203:     # 把活跃管理员降级或停用前，先按 id ASC 锁住全部活跃管理员行：固定加锁顺序
204:     # 防死锁，锁后 refresh 目标再计算剩余数量，防两个管理员并发互相降级。
205:     demote_or_disable_active_admin = (
206:         target.role == "admin"
207:         and target.status == "active"
208:         and (payload.role == "user" or payload.status == "disabled")
209:     )
210:     if demote_or_disable_active_admin:
211:         locked_ids = list(
212:             (
213:                 await db.execute(
214:                     select(User.id)
215:                     .where(User.role == "admin", User.status == "active")
216:                     .order_by(User.id)
217:                     .with_for_update()
218:                 )
219:             ).scalars()
220:         )
221:         await db.refresh(target)
222:         remaining = len(locked_ids) - (1 if target.id in locked_ids else 0)
223:         if target.role == "admin" and target.status == "active" and remaining == 0:
224:             raise ConflictError(
225:                 "不能移除最后一个活跃管理员",
226:                 code="last_admin_protected",
227:                 details={"active_admins": 1},
228:             )
229: 
230:     if payload.role is not None:
231:         target.role = payload.role
232:     if payload.status is not None:
233:         target.status = payload.status
234: 
235:     await write_audit(
236:         db,
237:         actor_type="user",
238:         actor_id=str(admin.id),
239:         action="admin.user.update",
240:         resource_type="user",
241:         resource_id=str(target.id),
242:         detail={
243:             "fields": sorted(changed),
244:             "role": target.role,
245:             "status": target.status,
246:         },
247:     )
248:     await db.commit()
249:     await db.refresh(target)
250:     return _to_out(target)

288: def _counts_by_status(rows: Any) -> dict[str, int]:
289:     """把 ``GROUP BY status`` 的 ``(status, count)`` 行汇总成字典。
290: 
291:     某状态没有数据时字典里没有该键，由调用方按固定状态元组补 ``0``，保证
292:     响应里的状态键始终存在。
293:     """
294:     counts: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
295:     for status, count in rows:
296:         counts[status] += int(count or 0)
297:     return counts

300: async def build_overview(db: AsyncSession) -> AdminOverviewOut:
301:     """实时汇总管理台只读概览。
302: 
303:     计数口径：``users``/``conversations``/``messages``/``runs``/``a2a_tasks``/
304:     ``knowledge`` 为全表原始计数（含软删/失败/终态），``conversations.deleted``
305:     单列；``attachments.total`` 只计 ``status != 'deleted'`` 的行，
306:     ``storage_bytes`` 为这些行的 ``COALESCE(SUM(size_bytes), 0)``，``deleted``
307:     单独计数。所有状态键始终存在，无数据时为 ``0``。
308: 
309:     SQL 口径：每张表最多一条聚合查询，共 8 条（``users`` 一条
310:     ``GROUP BY status, role``；``conversations``/``runs``/``a2a_tasks``/
311:     ``knowledge_documents``/``attachments`` 各一条 ``GROUP BY status``；
312:     ``messages``/``knowledge_chunks`` 各一条 ``COUNT``），不加载 ORM 行、不做 N+1。
313: 
314:     性能口径：精确计数，O(表大小)；管理端低频只读；表规模增大后再评估统计表，
315:     不在 M8。
316:     """
317:     # 1) users：一条 GROUP BY status, role 同时得到 total/active/disabled/admins。
318:     user_rows = (
319:         await db.execute(
320:             select(User.status, User.role, func.count(User.id)).group_by(
321:                 User.status, User.role
322:             )
323:         )
324:     ).all()
325:     users_by_status: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
326:     users_by_role: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
327:     users_total = 0
328:     for status, role, count in user_rows:
329:         value = int(count or 0)
330:         users_by_status[status] += value
331:         users_by_role[role] += value
332:         users_total += value
333: 
334:     # 2) conversations：全表 GROUP BY status，deleted 单列。
335:     conversation_counts = _counts_by_status(
336:         (
337:             await db.execute(
338:                 select(Conversation.status, func.count(Conversation.id)).group_by(
339:                     Conversation.status
340:                 )
341:             )
342:         ).all()
343:     )
344: 
345:     # 3) messages：一条 COUNT。
346:     messages_total = int(await db.scalar(select(func.count(Message.id))) or 0)
347: 
348:     # 4) runs：全表 GROUP BY status，固定状态键由响应模型补齐。
349:     run_counts = _counts_by_status(
350:         (
351:             await db.execute(
352:                 select(Run.status, func.count(Run.id)).group_by(Run.status)
353:             )
354:         ).all()
355:     )
356: 
357:     # 5) a2a_tasks：全表 GROUP BY state。
358:     a2a_counts = _counts_by_status(
359:         (
360:             await db.execute(
361:                 select(A2aTask.state, func.count(A2aTask.id)).group_by(A2aTask.state)
362:             )
363:         ).all()
364:     )
365: 
366:     # 6) knowledge_documents：全表 GROUP BY status。
367:     document_counts = _counts_by_status(
368:         (
369:             await db.execute(
370:                 select(
371:                     KnowledgeDocument.status, func.count(KnowledgeDocument.id)
372:                 ).group_by(KnowledgeDocument.status)
373:             )
374:         ).all()
375:     )
376: 
377:     # 7) knowledge_chunks：一条 COUNT。
378:     chunks_total = int(await db.scalar(select(func.count(KnowledgeChunk.id))) or 0)
379: 
380:     # 8) attachments：一条 GROUP BY status + SUM(size_bytes)；deleted 不计入
381:     # total/storage_bytes，只单独计数。
382:     attachment_rows = (
383:         await db.execute(
384:             select(
385:                 Attachment.status,
386:                 func.count(Attachment.id),
387:                 func.coalesce(func.sum(Attachment.size_bytes), 0),
388:             ).group_by(Attachment.status)
389:         )
390:     ).all()
391:     attachments_total = 0
392:     attachments_storage_bytes = 0
393:     attachments_deleted = 0
394:     for status, count, size_bytes in attachment_rows:
395:         status_count = int(count or 0)
396:         if status == "deleted":
397:             attachments_deleted += status_count
398:             continue
399:         attachments_total += status_count
400:         attachments_storage_bytes += int(size_bytes or 0)
401: 
402:     return AdminOverviewOut(
403:         generated_at=datetime.now(UTC),
404:         users=AdminOverviewUsers(
405:             total=users_total,

async def list_agents(
    db: AsyncSession,
    *,
    health_status: str | None,
    enabled: bool | None,
    q: str | None,
    limit: int,
    cursor: str | None,
) -> AgentPage:
    filters = [RemoteAgent.deleted_at.is_(None)]
    if health_status:
        filters.append(RemoteAgent.health_status == health_status)
    if enabled is not None:
        filters.append(RemoteAgent.enabled == enabled)
    if q:
        pattern = f"%{q}%"
        filters.append(
            or_(
                RemoteAgent.name.ilike(pattern),
                RemoteAgent.slug.ilike(pattern),
                RemoteAgent.description.ilike(pattern),
            )
        )

    decoded = decode_cursor(cursor)
    if decoded.get("created_at") and decoded.get("id"):
        from datetime import datetime as dt

        try:
            since = dt.fromisoformat(str(decoded["created_at"]))
            filters.append(
                or_(
                    RemoteAgent.created_at < since,
                    and_(RemoteAgent.created_at == since, RemoteAgent.id < uuid.UUID(str(decoded["id"]))),
                )
            )
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise ValidationFailedError("分页游标无效") from exc

    stmt = (
        select(RemoteAgent)
        .where(*filters)
        .order_by(RemoteAgent.created_at.desc(), RemoteAgent.id.desc())
        .limit(limit + 1)
    )
    rows = list((await db.execute(stmt)).scalars())
    has_more = len(rows) > limit
    rows = rows[:limit]

    recent = await _latest_tasks_map(db, [item.id for item in rows])
    items = [_agent_out(item, recent_task=recent.get(item.id)) for item in rows]
    stats = await _agent_stats(db, filters)
    next_cursor = None
    if has_more and rows:
        last = rows[-1]
        next_cursor = encode_cursor({"created_at": last.created_at, "id": last.id})
    return AgentPage(items=items, next_cursor=next_cursor, has_more=has_more, stats=stats)


async def _latest_tasks_map(db: AsyncSession, agent_ids: list[uuid.UUID]) -> dict[uuid.UUID, A2aTask]:
    if not agent_ids:
        return {}
    latest = (
        select(
            A2aTask.remote_agent_id,
            func.max(A2aTask.created_at).label("max_created"),
        )
        .where(A2aTask.remote_agent_id.in_(agent_ids))
        .group_by(A2aTask.remote_agent_id)
        .subquery()
    )
    rows = (
        await db.execute(
            select(A2aTask)
            .join(
                latest,
                and_(
                    A2aTask.remote_agent_id == latest.c.remote_agent_id,
                    A2aTask.created_at == latest.c.max_created,
                ),
            )
            .order_by(A2aTask.created_at.desc())
            .limit(len(agent_ids))
        )
    ).scalars()
    result: dict[uuid.UUID, A2aTask] = {}
    for task in rows:
        result.setdefault(task.remote_agent_id, task)
    return result

async def _agent_stats(db: AsyncSession, filters: list) -> AgentStats:
    base = [*filters]
    stats = AgentStats()
    for key, value in {
        "total": None,
        "healthy": "healthy",
        "degraded": "degraded",
        "unhealthy": "unhealthy",
    }.items():
        extra = [RemoteAgent.health_status == value] if value else []
        count = await db.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(RemoteAgent).where(*base, *extra))
        setattr(stats, key, int(count or 0))
    stats.enabled = int(
        await db.scalar(
            select(func.count()).select_from(RemoteAgent).where(*base, RemoteAgent.enabled.is_(True))
        )
        or 0
    )
    stats.disabled = int(
        await db.scalar(
            select(func.count()).select_from(RemoteAgent).where(*base, RemoteAgent.enabled.is_(False))
        )
        or 0
    )
    return stats

async def update_agent(
    db: AsyncSession, user: User, agent_id: uuid.UUID, payload: AgentUpdateRequest
) -> AgentDetailOut:
    agent = await _get_agent(db, agent_id)
    changed: list[str] = []
    if payload.name is not None and payload.name != agent.name:
        agent.name = payload.name[:128]
        agent.name_edited = True
        changed.append("name")
    if payload.enabled is not None and payload.enabled != agent.enabled:
        agent.enabled = payload.enabled
        changed.append("enabled")
    if payload.auth is not None:
        _apply_auth(agent, agent.card or {}, payload.auth, role=user.role)
        changed.append("auth")
    if payload.headers is not None:
        stored, hint = normalize_headers(
            payload.headers, allow_platform_secret=user.role == "admin"
        )
        agent.headers = stored
        if hint:
            agent.auth_hint = hint
        changed.append("headers")
    if changed:
        await write_audit(
            db,
            actor_type="user",
            actor_id=str(user.id),
            action="agent.updated",
            resource_type="agent",
            resource_id=str(agent.id),
            detail={"fields": changed},
        )
        await db.commit()
        await db.refresh(agent)
    return await _detail_with_recent(db, agent)


async def admin_update_agent(
    db: AsyncSession,
    admin: User,
    agent_id: uuid.UUID,
    payload: AdminAgentUpdateRequest,
) -> AgentDetailOut:
    """管理台 PATCH 全局 Agent：只改白名单字段，真实变更才写审计。

    ``name`` 变化会置 ``name_edited=True``，后续 refresh 不再用 Card 名称覆盖；
    ``auth`` 与 ``headers`` 复用注册路径的 ``_apply_auth``/``normalize_headers``，
    允许 ``secret:`` 平台密钥引用。只读字段由 ``extra="forbid"`` 在 422 阶段拦截。
    """
    agent = await _get_agent(db, agent_id)
    changed: list[str] = []
    if payload.name is not None and payload.name != agent.name:
        agent.name = payload.name[:128]
        agent.name_edited = True
        changed.append("name")
    if payload.enabled is not None and payload.enabled != agent.enabled:
        agent.enabled = payload.enabled
        changed.append("enabled")
    if (
        payload.requires_approval is not None
        and payload.requires_approval != agent.requires_approval
    ):
        agent.requires_approval = payload.requires_approval
        changed.append("requires_approval")
    if payload.auth is not None:
        before_auth = (
            agent.auth_type,
            agent.auth_scheme,
            agent.secret_ref,
            agent.auth_hint,
        )
        _apply_auth(agent, agent.card or {}, payload.auth, role="admin")
        after_auth = (
            agent.auth_type,
            agent.auth_scheme,
            agent.secret_ref,
            agent.auth_hint,
        )
        if after_auth != before_auth:
            changed.append("auth")
    if payload.headers is not None:
        stored, hint = normalize_headers(
            payload.headers, allow_platform_secret=True
        )
        if stored != (agent.headers or {}):
            agent.headers = stored
            if hint:
                agent.auth_hint = hint
            changed.append("headers")
    if changed:
        await write_audit(
            db,
            actor_type="user",
            actor_id=str(admin.id),
            action="agent.updated",
            resource_type="agent",
            resource_id=str(agent.id),
            detail={"fields": changed, "source": "admin"},
        )
        await db.commit()
        await db.refresh(agent)
    return await _detail_with_recent(db, agent)

def _apply_auth(
    agent: RemoteAgent,
    card: dict,
    auth: object | None,
    *,
    role: str,
) -> None:
    """把注册/更新时的 auth 输入落到 Agent；secret_ref 只存引用。

    ``secret:NAME`` 引用平台密钥，仅管理员可配置；普通用户只能用 ``env:``。
    """
    if auth is None:
        return
    auth_type = getattr(auth, "type", None) or "none"
    secret_ref = (getattr(auth, "secret_ref", None) or "").strip() or None
    if secret_ref and secret_ref.startswith("secret:") and role != "admin":
        from app.core.errors import ValidationFailedError

        raise ValidationFailedError(
            "secret: 引用仅管理员可配置", code="secret_ref_not_allowed"
        )
    if auth_type == "none":
        agent.auth_type = "none"
        agent.auth_scheme = "none"
        agent.secret_ref = None
        return
    if auth_type == "oauth2":
        agent.auth_type = "oauth2"
        agent.auth_scheme = "oauth2"
        agent.secret_ref = None
        return
    # api_key：scheme 优先从 Card 推断，其次默认 bearer。
    agent.auth_type = "api_key"
    agent.auth_scheme = _infer_auth_scheme(card) if agent.auth_scheme == "none" else agent.auth_scheme
    if agent.auth_scheme in {"none", "oauth2"}:
        agent.auth_scheme = "bearer"
    agent.secret_ref = secret_ref
    if secret_ref:
        agent.auth_hint = secret_ref


async def _resolved_headers(db: AsyncSession, agent: RemoteAgent) -> dict[str, str]:
    """调用远程时使用的请求头（env:/secret: 引用与密文还原）。"""
    headers = await resolve_headers_async(db, agent.headers or {})
    if agent.secret_ref and agent.auth_type == "api_key":
        resolved = await resolve_headers_async(
            db, {"Authorization": {"secret_ref": agent.secret_ref}}
        )
        if resolved:
            headers["Authorization"] = resolved["Authorization"]
    return headers

"""MCP 模块 DTO。"""

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any, Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, field_validator, model_validator

McpTransport = Literal["streamable_http", "sse", "stdio"]
McpHealth = Literal["unknown", "healthy", "unhealthy", "disabled"]
McpRisk = Literal["read", "write", "destructive", "unknown"]


class McpServerCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=128)
    slug: str = Field(min_length=2, max_length=64, pattern=r"^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,63}$")
    description: str = Field(default="", max_length=2000)
    transport: McpTransport = "streamable_http"
    url: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=2048)
    headers: dict[str, str] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    command: str | None = Field(
        default=None, max_length=512, description="stdio 传输必填（仅管理员可用）"
    )
    args: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=32)

    @field_validator("name", "description")
    @classmethod
    def _strip(cls, value: str) -> str:
        return value.strip()


class McpServerUpdateRequest(BaseModel):
    name: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=128)
    description: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=2000)
    url: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=2048)
    headers: dict[str, str] | None = None
    auto_inject: bool | None = None


class AdminMcpServerUpdateRequest(McpServerUpdateRequest):
    """管理台更新系统 MCP：在白名单字段上扩展全局启停与强制停用。

    ``slug``/``transport``/``command``/``args`` 在创建时确定，不可改；未知字段
    （包括这些只读字段）显式 422。至少提交一项非空值。
    """

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    enabled: bool | None = None
    force_disabled: bool | None = None

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _require_at_least_one_field(self) -> AdminMcpServerUpdateRequest:
        if all(
            value is None
            for value in (
                self.name,
                self.description,
                self.url,
                self.headers,
                self.auto_inject,
                self.enabled,
                self.force_disabled,
            )
        ):
            raise ValueError("至少需要修改一个字段")
        return self

    @field_validator("name")
    @classmethod
    def _reject_blank_name(cls, value: str | None) -> str | None:
        """管理端改名必须是有内容的名称；纯空白提前 422 而不是落库空串。"""
        if value is None:
            return None
        value = value.strip()
        if not value:
            raise ValueError("name 不能为空白")
        return value

if server is None:
        raise NotFoundError("系统 MCP 服务器不存在")
